relationships.description: The link names the operation that a client may call next after receiving this response, identifying it by operationId or operationRef so that the mapped response or request values can populate that operation's parameters or request body.
relationships.evidence: The Link Object under a response's 'links' map has an 'operationId' that matches the target operation's operationId, or an 'operationRef' JSON pointer that resolves to that operation's path item and method.

relationships.description: The link depends on a data shape whose properties are the source of its runtime expressions (for example $response.body#/id) or the target of its parameter and request-body mappings, so the referenced schema defines which values the link can carry from one call to the next.
relationships.evidence: A runtime expression in the link's 'parameters' or 'requestBody' points to a JSON path that exists in the response or request schema of the owning operation, or to a property of the target operation's parameter or request-body schema.

relationships.description: The link is associated with a documentation category that groups the follow-on operation it describes, so that tooling can present the link among the tagged operations it leads to.
relationships.evidence: The operation named by the link's operationId or operationRef lists this tag in its 'tags' array, or a vendor extension on the Link Object names the tag explicitly.

relationships.description: The link sends the follow-on call to this server base URL rather than to the target operation's default servers, overriding where that next request is addressed.
relationships.evidence: The Link Object's 'server' field declares a Server Object whose url, with any variables substituted, is the base URL used when following the link.

notes: Link→schema and link→tag have no field in the OpenAPI Link Object; both are only indirect, via runtime expressions or the target operation's tags. Link→tag is especially weak and arguably derivable from link→operation plus operation→tag. Link→server is valid, since Link Object has a 'server' field.
